personal.body_note: ONE-SYSTEM FLAGSHIP BODY — Smart Personal (Nu, 2026-10-22 one-system cure): the personal-v5 base AS the app — cover + identity head lead, named blocks (Wall, About, Today, Smart Notes, Connections, Message, Inbox, Growth, Lists, Reports, Settings) shown one at a time behind the page's own nav tabs, twin-plus (Hub verbatim, 48x48) as the only plus system, Smart Mail messaging, record-only invites, live Reports/Today, profile picture + install inside the Settings block only. Canonical base the Business + Space models derive from. + TEN-STAR PASS (2026-10-22): Reports is a living dashboard (donut activity mix, 7-day bars from real timestamps, counting-up numbers, one human meaning sentence per stat) and the Smart Tabs ribbon provably drifts one-way on a duplicated, always-overflowing track. + TEN-STAR BATCH 2 (2026-10-22): no naked numbers anywhere (wall/inbox counts carry sentences), Today is the page's own pulse (latest post + message + invite, kind-labeled, with a generated pulse sentence), the wall is inhabited (spectrum initial avatars per author, recent-activity glow), Growth shows the invite Journey Funnel (recorded → opened → joined with conversions and the honest record-only truth), Connections leads with a live Faces Board (real people from the page's own wall/mail/invites, one-tap message), the inbox reads as conversations (sender faces, snippets, relative times, NEW glow for mail arrived since the last visit on this device, summary sentence), every Settings control is real (flips, persists, acts — drift/motion/auto-refresh + public-profile genuinely closing posting and messaging + notifications gating the inbox dot — and says what it did), and one life pass covers all blocks (fadeUp entrances, breathing section dots, ignite-on-touch in each card's own spectrum color). + DASHBOARD VIEW (2026-10-22, Shawn's dashboard-button doctrine): every flagship now carries its own Dashboard — a prominent Dashboard button on Home (and a Dashboard nav tab) opens the 'Your World, Live' view (data-block="dashboard"), the same composition the Dashboard door opens on: Health Gauge + health sentence, Pulse Strip with real 7-day sparklines, Trend Panel + Journey Funnel + Mix Donut, Faces Board, a generated Insight Feed, latest conversations, and the Connections/Plug-ins strip (native + community LIVE on real data; website / social feeds / AIs as honest invitations with no invented numbers) — all computed live from the page's own tables by the door-layer engine (factory-models/src/dash-{style,blocks,script}.html). Home itself is unchanged: cover + wall lead, exactly as before. + LIVING GRAPHICS PASS (2026-10-22, Nu; Shawn's visual-life verdict + every-page law + Naya 3 v3 harvest): the data objects themselves are now lit, physical and moving — lit growing/breathing bars with value pills in recessed wells, the donut as a beveled jewel (traveling sheen, black gaps, rim dots, lit center numerals), living sparklines (area fill + trace + breathing head dot), the gauge as an instrument (gem ticks, travelling gem, update sweep), funnel stages as 3D slabs with flowing light arrows and lit count pills, faces as coins with rotating hot arcs, lit numerals everywhere, period tabs (7d/30d/All) that redraw with animation, skeleton shimmer, ignite-on-touch, a ~40% text diet on Dashboard/Reports, PLUS the v3 harvest in our grammar: insights reframed as 'Your next best moves' (evidence folded), a real-data Spotlight panel (rule: waiting conversation > joined milestone > invites waiting > newest wall post > new world), a 'Your life, live' strip with visible interconnection markers (Today's newest item is badged 'ALSO ON YOUR DASHBOARD'), a 1.25s verified-change flash when live data changes a count/stage/insight, and a REAL help-shape-it feedback door that posts into the page's own Smart Mail. Plug-ins stay first-class. Sources: factory-models/src/{os,dash}-{style,blocks,script}.html. + FRONT CURE (2026-10-22): stats-first front — pulse (ACTIVE INTELLIGENCE: count-up, breathing sparkline head, change flash, ambient light) → trend/funnel/donut → faces → next best moves (pick rule leads) → conversations → plug-ins as jewel tiles with lit numerals; hero banner, synthetic Health Gauge, Spotlight banner and life strip retired; icon jewel system on every icon; recursive elevation audited + INTERROGATION CURE (2026-10-22): Smart Notes made true (capture lands in-block, Save persists + Saved shelf, samples honestly labeled), ghost people removed, Lists real, Library block, service worker + the page's own manifest, lit Settings switches, Back-button view history, the orb circle system, faces by spectrum position, funnel Recorded → Joined + D1 REPAIR (2026-10-22): the Reports trend 'All' period bucketizes the whole story (weekly buckets spanning the full history) instead of collapsing to today's bucket — All >= 30d >= 7d on every body + LEFTOVER CURE (2026-10-22, post-re-audit): 'people around you' excludes the owner on every surface (Faces headline, both dashboard engines, plug-ins) with the owner's tile badged 'You'; Today header reads 'Today' and its latest sentence takes 'an invite'; the funnel comment + feature text no longer name the retired stage + EYE-PASS CURE (2026-10-22, Shawn's screenshot walk): the cover Dashboard band retired into the action row; hover law — edge ignites, text stays white; the spectrum walk runs by position everywhere (nav, circles, donuts, moves, faces, plug-ins); initials are orbs (the connections-2.html standard) and Connections is full-width rows; About grew editable About/Goals/Mission/Vision/What I love/What I don't/My motto sections; the Today pill is gone, kind jewels instead; plug-in tiles deep black with walk accents; buttons deeper; top tabs drift right while the bottom ribbon drifts left; board ignition follows the walk by board order + EYE ROUND 2 (2026-10-22, Shawn's eye rounds 2-2d): the hero action row deleted (no duplicated navigation) and Invite a friend rides the tab bar; cover integrity — the picture displays whole, identity overlays its bottom, tabs level with its bottom edge; Message dictation + auto-growing box; About reordered (Motto first, Facts last) with My/Our pronoun grammar and dictation on every field; Settings loses the picture card (tap the picture itself), install simplified to one line + Install this app, smart-app language sweep, readable Settings text; board ignition follows the walk by board order + EYE ROUND 3 (2026-10-22): header composition — the identity sits inside the cover (bottom scrim + overlay), ONE navigation row, Invite a friend is an action tab that lands on the invite form; board re-renders, Growth list synced) + Growth rows drop the 'Sends people to' line + Settings: Public profile switch moves into the Identity card (one choice: public or private), the display-only Data & privacy card and the App alias/Model lines are removed + Library leaves the tab list: its two cards are the About view's Questions & answers block (ids unchanged); Save offers save-into-a-list (pick an existing list or name a new one) on Smart Note cards, Naya Note cards and message saves; device lists import once, without loss + FLAGSHIP PASS (2026-10-23, Shawn's order): the Dashboard Smart Links board is ALIVE — counted numbers animate to their real values and re-read every 30s while the Dashboard is open, every link carries its own 14-day clicks graph (lit bars in a recessed well, real rows only), all board text is white, the board stack deepens + Plug-ins strip: horizontal rectangles, one full-width row per source, whose doors do the real thing (this app -> Home, community -> People, website -> Smart Factory, Booking -> nayanet.live/book slug-aware, Payments -> nayanet.live/pay slug-aware;
